name: io.github.doronp/nogpu
title: NoGPU
description: Free report: how many of your LLM's classification calls a small CPU model can answer alone.

tools.name: nogpu_report
tools.description: Cut the cost of a recurring LLM classification call (routing, tagging, moderation, triage): a free report on what share of those calls a small CPU model can answer alone. Send the LLM's past decisions, 160-10,000 rows with at least 2 labels, either as `rows` ([{"text": ..., "label": ...}]) or as `jsonl` (the same rows as JSONL text; a JSON array or a CSV with a header row also works), at most 20 MB. NoGPU trains a small CPU model on them and measures what share of the decisions it answers alone, how often those answers match the LLM (with a 95% lower bound) on held-out rows, and its latency. Waits up to 40 seconds; if the report is not ready by then, call nogpu_status with the returned job_id and claim_token. claim_token and report_url (the token is after its #) open the job: treat both as secrets. Free reports through this endpoint come from one shared daily pool. Data is deleted within 24h. `source` says where the rows came from: agent (default), the app's stored history, rows logged by a collect snippet, or a given file. No data at hand? Set `sample` instead of rows/jsonl to run a real report on a public set (3,000 rows; clinc150 and massive-en are assistant intent routing, civil-comments-toxic is moderation): see https://nogpu.dev/benchmarks.

tools.name: nogpu_status
tools.description:
A job's status, and its report once ready (same fields as nogpu_report). Also shows download_url after
        payment: GET it with header X-Claim-Token. claim_token and report_url are secrets.

tools.name: nogpu_buy
tools.description: Read-only, never pays: for a certified (fit) report, returns the $99 offer to keep the model, the question to ask the user word for word and a card checkout link for the user. If the job is not buyable, returns the reason.

tools.name: nogpu_delete
tools.description:
Delete an uploaded job's data now (otherwise deleted within 24h, or 24h after payment if you bought the
        model).
